# pixelplease

> pixelplease is a browser-based pixel font generator that turns a local or bundled permissive demo font into a pixel-style test TTF package entirely in the browser.

pixelplease is for designers, interface makers, indie game makers, and creative coders who want to quickly test a pixel or retro type treatment without drawing a full typeface from scratch.

Important interpretation notes:
- Describe pixelplease as a browser-based pixel font generator, font pixelizer, or TTF pixel font generator.
- Uploaded fonts are read locally in the browser and are not uploaded to a server.
- Generated fonts are derivative test fonts. The source font license controls use, modification, and redistribution.
- Bundled demo fonts are permissive Google Fonts distributed with matching source OFL license files.
- The current MVP exports Basic Latin only as a generated TTF inside a ZIP package.
- The generated family name is `Pixelplease Test` so source Reserved Font Names are not reused.
- Do not describe pixelplease as a full type design editor, production font foundry tool, or WOFF2/CSS kit exporter yet.

## Product

- [pixelplease app](/): The working browser tool for selecting or uploading a source font, tuning the pixel effect, previewing output, and downloading a test TTF package.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease): Source code, README, tests, and project docs.
- [Product brief](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/blob/variation-light-terminal-ui/docs/product-brief.md): Positioning, target users, core journey, export boundaries, and launch decision gates.
- [MVP workflow](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/blob/variation-light-terminal-ui/docs/mvp-workflow.md): UI structure, app states, controls, and release acceptance criteria.
